**3. Islington.** Islington over-indexes 1.59x vs the general going-out crowd (lift rank 3, raw heat rank 3). Anchors: Victoria Miro, The Courtauld Institute of Art, Caffè Estorick. Co-launch with Toast; aim at 55 and older.
